answer_1.quote: We propose the segment-aware self-attention based Transformer for TS, named SA-Transformer, which achieves superior performance to the naive Transformer.
answer_1.outputs: Generated translation suggestions (alternative spans) for incorrect words/phrases in machine-translated sentences.

answer_2.quote: For evaluation, we report the scores of BLEU and BLEURT on the test sets of WeTS. Both of the two scores are calculated between the top-1 generated suggestion against the golden suggestions in the reference.
